description: Every toy on the Hamleys Festive 15 for Christmas 2026, with today's cheapest UK prices, plus which are Hamleys-only and which to buy now.
intro:
**The Hamleys top toys for Christmas 2026, its 'Festive 15', include the Primal Hatch Megalodon, the Thunder Unicorn, Barbie in the Nutcracker dolls and Articulate Under Pressure.** The biggest saving today is the Megalodon at £32.99 from Smyths, against a £55 'was' price at Argos.

Hamleys announced the list on 14 October 2026. Five of the toys are Hamleys' own brand and only sold there; the rest are big brands you can compare. Every price below was checked on 10 November 2026.

body:
## The Hamleys Festive 15 for Christmas 2026

Every autumn Hamleys picks the toys it expects to sell best at Christmas. The 2026 list came out on 14 October. Here it is, with the age Hamleys gives each toy:

- **Movers and Shakers** soft toys (18 months+), Hamleys own brand
- **Thunder Unicorn** (3+), Hamleys own brand
- **Barbie in The Nutcracker** Clara and Sugar Plum dolls (4+)
- **Play-Doh Stamp & Spin Pizza Playset** (4+)
- **Articulate Under Pressure** (8+)
- **Primal Hatch Megalodon** (3+; other shops say 5+)
- **Doctor Doom action figure** (4+)
- **ScorpiX RC Transforming Car** (7+), Hamleys own brand
- **Hatsune Miku figure** (7+)
- **The Big Squij** squishy range (3+)
- **Numberblocks Sing and Record Music Player** (3+)
- **LEGO Marvel Doctor Doom Bust 76345** (18+)
- **Ready, Pedal, Go Peppa** (3+)
- **Hamleys Wooden London Taxi** (12 months+), Hamleys own brand
- **Magic 3D Track Set**, 171 pieces, Hamleys own brand

The theme this year is simple, hands-on play, with a few tech toys and some grown-up collectables. There's no single 'must-have' gadget on the list.

## Where each toy is cheapest

**Branded toys are often cheaper at Smyths or Argos.** Smyths had the lowest price we found today on most of them, and it was never beaten where Argos sold the same toy. The Megalodon is the stand-out: £32.99 at Smyths and £33 at Argos, where it's down from £55. The Barbie Clara doll is £30 at both Argos and The Entertainer, and the Numberblocks player is £26.95 direct from Learning Resources.

**Hamleys' own-brand toys are only sold at Hamleys.** That's the Thunder Unicorn, ScorpiX car, Movers and Shakers, the wooden taxi and the Magic 3D Track Set. You can't compare them with another shop, so judge them on what they are, not on the discount. Hamleys often cuts its own-brand range in the run-up to Black Friday. In early November we saw many own-brand toys at half price (see our [Hamleys Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/hamleys-black-friday-2026/)). When we checked on 10 November, the Hamleys homepage had 10% off selected toys with the code NEW10. Hamleys' product pages didn't load for us today, so check the price on the [Hamleys website](https://www.hamleys.com/) before you buy.

## Buy now or wait for Black Friday?

Black Friday is on **Friday 27 November 2026**. Our view on this list:

- **Buy now:** the Megalodon (already £22 off at Argos and cheaper again at Smyths) and anything with low stock, like the Barbie Clara doll. Toys on a Hamleys 'top toys' list get a lot of press, and the popular ones tend to sell out in early December.
- **Worth waiting for:** the Lego Doctor Doom Bust. Lego is one of the most heavily discounted brands on Black Friday, so a few pounds off now may become more. Our [Lego Black Friday deals guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) tracks where sets are cheapest.
- **Either way:** cheaper toys like Play-Doh and the Big Squij won't move much. Buy them when it suits you.

## How to use a 'top toys' list

A retailer's list is a good starting point, but it's not a shopping list. Hamleys picks toys it wants to sell, including its own. Check the age rating (the Lego bust is for adults, not children), think about batteries for the electronic toys, and remember that a cheaper gift a child loves beats a list toy they'll ignore.

For more ideas, see our [Christmas gifts for kids under £20](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-kids-under-20/), our [STEM gifts guide](/guides/stem-gifts-for-kids/), and everything on our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/) page.

## FAQs

### What is the Hamleys top toy for Christmas 2026?

Hamleys doesn't name a single winner. Its 'Festive 15' list includes the Primal Hatch Megalodon, the Thunder Unicorn, the Barbie Nutcracker dolls and Articulate Under Pressure, among others.

### When did Hamleys announce its Christmas 2026 toy list?

On 14 October 2026.

### Can I buy the Hamleys top toys at other shops?

The branded ones, yes. Smyths, Argos and The Entertainer stock most of them, often for less. The five Hamleys own-brand toys are only sold at Hamleys.

### Will these toys sell out?

The most popular ones often do by early December. Some, like the Barbie Clara doll, were already low in stock at The Entertainer on 10 November. If a child has their heart set on one, buy it soon.

### Are the Hamleys toys cheaper on Black Friday?

Some will be. Hamleys usually discounts its own-brand range, and big brands like Lego tend to drop across all retailers. Toys likely to sell out are worth buying now rather than gambling on a small Black Friday saving.
